title: Synthetic Training Manual: Caregiver Follow-Up Plan

manual_pages.title: Purpose and trigger
sections: SYNTHETIC TRAINING ONLY. This is not clinical guidance.
After a SYNTHETIC_YELLOW result, create a follow-up plan for the current patient's primary caregiver.
The plan must retain the source quotation, trigger identifier, and requested time.

manual_pages.title: Recipient and content
sections: Resolve the recipient only through the patient.primary-caregiver topology relation.
Use the approved synthetic follow-up template, policy, and adapter versions.
Do not put a phone number, email address, provider endpoint, secret, or raw destination in the clinical or planning request.

manual_pages.title: Planning boundary
sections: The expected result is a version-locked request in requested state and planning_only runtime status.
The plan does not authorize, queue, send, accept a provider result, or claim delivery.
If no unique caregiver relation is available, record unassigned and do not create an effect request.

must_include: do not create an effect request
